summary_en: 900,000 shares to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-03 at last close price of ¥2,896. Represents 22.8% of the ¥17.0B, 5.55M-share authorization granted May 12 and July 31, 2026 (13.91% of S/O ex-treasury). To date, ¥460.8M and 180,000 shares acquired under the same authorization.
title_en: Notice on Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Negotiated Trade (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On July 31, 2026, EIZO Corporation's board approved the execution terms for a treasury share acquisition block under a broader authorization granted on May 12 and July 31, 2026. The company will acquire 900,000 shares of its own common stock via off-hours negotiated trade (ToSTNeT-3) on August 3, 2026, at the prior trading day's close price of ¥2,896 per share. This block represents 22.8% of the ¥17.0 billion authorization covering up to 5.55 million shares (13.91% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) over the period May 25, 2026 through May 24, 2027. As of July 30, 2026, the company had already acquired 180,000 shares for ¥460.8 million under this same authorization. The company notes that multiple shareholders have expressed intent to sell their holdings, prompting the transaction.
